name: QTT Subscription Item
description: An add-on purchased on top of a Product Subscription's base plan (extra seats, extra AI credits, ...) — additive to the plan's own QTT Plan Feature limits inside the entitlement engine (Phase 5), via the optional feature_key link.

fields.label: Item Type
fields.description: e.g. 'extra_instructor_seats', 'extra_ai_credits' — product-defined, never a platform-hardcoded list.

fields.label: Feature Key
fields.description: Which QTT Plan Feature.feature_key this add-on's `quantity` is added to (e.g. an 'extra_instructor_seats' item with feature_key 'max_instructors'). Left blank for a pure billing line item with no entitlement effect (e.g. a one-time setup fee).
